text:
ITEM 1 | Golden-brown piece with a crumbly, breadcrumb-like or seed-studded crust on the outer surface, pale pinkish-cream interior visible at one cut end, moderately dry matte surface with slight sheen, rectangular block about 5 cm long by 3 cm wide and about 2 cm thick, sitting alone on the upper-left area of the white square plate | 45

ITEM 2 | Golden-brown piece with a crumbly, seasoned crust showing darker browned spots, pale pink flesh exposed at one cut side, slightly flaky edges, rectangular block about 5 cm long by 3 cm wide and about 2 cm thick, positioned at the lower-center of the white plate with small green flecks scattered near it | 45

ITEM 3 | Golden-brown piece with crumbly crust and a pale pink cut face showing layered texture, moderately dry, rectangular block about 4.5 cm long by 3 cm wide and about 2 cm thick, positioned on the right side of the white plate | 35

ITEM 4 | Finely chopped bright green pieces (scallion-like bits), scattered in small clusters across the plate, fresh and moist-looking, each piece under 0.5 cm, total visible amount very small | 2

ITEM 5 | Small scattered golden-brown crumbs and fragments from the crust, dry and loose, spread around the fish pieces on the plate | 3

ITEM 6 | Thin sprig of green herb with fine needle-like leaves, dry-looking, lying on the right side of the plate, about 4 cm long | 1
